translations.idiomatic: He enjoyed the company of scholars and cared nothing for horses, hounds, music, or women.

sentences.zh: 由中書宣使，出為寧晉主簿。

translations.literal: From Central Secretariat envoy he went out as registrar of Ningjin.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a Central Secretariat envoy, he was sent out as registrar of Ningjin.

sentences.zh: 改隆平縣達魯花赤，均賦興學，劭農平訟，橋梁、水防、備荒之政，無一不舉。

translations.literal: He was changed to darughachi of Longping County, equalizing levies, promoting schools, encouraging agriculture and settling lawsuits—policies for bridges, flood control, and famine preparedness, none of which he failed to undertake.
translations.idiomatic: As darughachi of Longping he equalized taxes, promoted schools, encouraged farming and settled lawsuits, and carried out every policy for bridges, flood control, and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 及滿去，民勒石以紀其政。

translations.literal: When his term ended and he departed, the people carved a stone to record his administration.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended the people set up a stone to commemorate his rule.

sentences.zh: 拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 時江西胡參政殺其弟，訟久不決，脫烈海牙一訊竟伏其辜。

translations.literal: At that time Administrative Commissioner Hu of Jiangxi had killed his younger brother; the lawsuit long went unresolved, but Tuoliehaiya with one examination made him confess his crime.
translations.idiomatic: When Administrative Commissioner Hu of Jiangxi killed his younger brother, the case dragged on until Tuoliehaiya tried it once and brought out a confession.

sentences.zh: 出僉燕南道肅政廉訪司事，務存大體，不事苛察。

translations.literal: He went out as concurrent administrative aide of the Yannan Circuit Surveillance Commission, aiming to preserve the broad principles and not engage in harsh scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: He served as concurrent administrative aide on the Yannan surveillance commission, keeping to broad principles and avoiding petty scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 在任六年，黜污吏百四十有奇。

translations.literal: In six years in office he dismissed more than a hundred and forty corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: In six years he dismissed more than a hundred and forty corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 召為戶部郎中，轉右司員外郎，陞右司郎中。

translations.literal: He was summoned as director of the Ministry of Revenue, transferred to outer director of the Right Department, and promoted to director of the Right Department.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as director of the Ministry of Revenue, made outer director of the Right Department, and promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 贊畫之力居多。

translations.literal: His contribution in planning and counsel was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: His contribution in counsel was the greatest.

sentences.zh: 仁宗在東宮，知其嗜學，出祕府經籍及聖賢圖像以賜，時人榮之。

translations.literal: When Renzong was in the Eastern Palace, knowing his love of learning, he produced classics from the secret repository and images of sages to bestow on him—men of the time honored this.
translations.idiomatic: While Renzong was crown prince, knowing his love of learning, he gave him classics from the imperial library and portraits of the sages—a mark of honor at the time.

sentences.zh: 母霍氏卒，哀毀骨立，事聞，賜鈔五萬貫，給葬事。

translations.literal: When his mother Lady Huo died, his grief wasted him to skin and bone; the matter was reported, and he was granted fifty thousand strings of paper money for funeral arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother Lady Huo died he mourned until he was wasted to skin and bone; the court heard of it and granted fifty thousand strings of paper money for the funeral.

sentences.zh: 起為吏部尚書，量能敘爵，以平允稱。

translations.literal: He was raised to Minister of Personnel, assigning ranks according to capacity, and was known for fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled as Minister of Personnel, he assigned ranks according to merit and was known for fairness.

sentences.zh: 改禮部尚書，領會同館事。

translations.literal: He was changed to Minister of Rites and took charge of the Hall of United Submission.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Minister of Rites and put in charge of the Hall of United Submission.

sentences.zh: 進中奉大夫、荊湖北道宣慰使。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand Master for Proper Service and Pacification Commissioner of the Jinghu North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Master for Proper Service and Pacification Commissioner of the northern Jinghu circuit.

sentences.zh: 適峽人艱食，脫烈海牙先發廩賑之，而後以聞。

translations.literal: It happened that the people of the gorges had scarce food; Tuoliehaiya first opened the granaries to relieve them and afterward reported it.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of the gorges were short of food, Tuoliehaiya opened the granaries to relieve them first and reported afterward.

sentences.zh: 朝議韙之。

translations.literal: Court discussion approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his action.

sentences.zh: 至治三年，遷淮東宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhizhi he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1323 he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 七月，以疾卒于廣陵，年六十有七，贈通奉大夫、河南江北等處行中書省參知政事、護軍，追封恒山郡公。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he died of illness at Guangling at the age of sixty-seven; posthumously granted Grand Master for Imperial Service, Vice Director of the Henan and Jiangbei Branch Secretariat, and Guardian of the Army, and enfeoffed as Duke of Hengshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he died of illness at Guangling at sixty-seven. He was posthumously honored as Grand Master for Imperial Service, Vice Director of the Henan and Jiangbei Branch Secretariat, and Guardian of the Army, and enfeoffed as Duke of Hengshan.

sentences.zh: 弟觀音奴，廉明材幹，亦仕至清顯云。

translations.literal: His younger brother Guanyinnu was incorrupt, clear-sighted, and capable, and also rose to eminent and pure office, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Guanyinnu was incorrupt and capable and likewise rose to high and honorable office.
